title: Owned Resource Result Adoption
objective: Adopt owned FFI resource results returned by compiled exact/native functions into standard generated resource tokens with correct identity, deterministic close, finalization, and lifecycle validation

handoff.summary: Compiled exact functions now adopt owned FFI resource results into the ordinary generated Python resource classes on native and dynamic paths. The generated wrapper derives the declaration identity, public module/class, and close export from the FFI declaration; native N-API holders retain their self-finalizing lifecycle while dynamic resources use the shared JavaScript finalization registry. FmpqMatrix regressions cover construction, cloning, use, independent liveness, explicit idempotent close, wrong and closed resources, native-disabled fallback, generated metadata, and forced-GC holder reclamation.
risks: The integration lane should repeat the full native suite after rebasing dependent resource work; this lane's full native suite passed before its final factory-cache-key hardening, and the focused lifecycle regression, architecture checks, and strict Python checks passed afterward.
next_steps: Rebase higher-weight resource-returning kernels onto this branch and verify they return their generated public resource classes without operation-specific wrappers.
